section.h1: Turn your website into an Android App
section.p: Create an APK or AAB from your website. Start with Quick Builder, customize every detail, or use Professional build settings.

div.p: Enter your website and choose how much you want to customize.

div.div: Backend URL is not configured yet. Set API_BASE in this theme's JavaScript before publishing.

div.label: Website URL *
div.div: Use a public HTTPS website URL.

div.label: App Icon
div.div: PNG, JPG or WEBP. Max 2 MB.

div.p: Professional mode uses a persistent app signing key on your backend. Keep your backend data volume and signing secret safe.

form.div: Only convert websites you own or have permission to package. APK KIE does not copy or host your website content.
